description: This file implements the TextToSpeech plugin class for a WPEFramework-based project, including initialization, deinitialization, registration, and cleanup logic for the TextToSpeech component. It also registers the plugin as a WPEFramework service.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: The main class implementing the TextToSpeech plugin functionality for the WPEFramework, handling lifecycle, registration, and cleanup.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the TextToSpeech plugin, sets up the TTS service, and registers notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregisters notifications, and releases resources.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles the remote connection deactivation event for cleanup.
